card.name: Partway through drug-label terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split in two or three parts, in drug-label text. It is usually the start of a section name, a brand name or a drug name, such as Adverse Reactions or paroxetine.

modes.label: Cross-reference section names
modes.description: The start of the second word in a bracketed section reference such as Adverse Reactions or Specific Populations.

modes.label: Inside drug and brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or generic name, often one that is repeated in the passage.
